objectives: Clarify user's original eight image/source flags without rerating artworks.
Capture exact reviewed Commons file and file load result in user's browser; never infer original versus photograph identity.
Preserve and display user numeric ratings read-only; no new aesthetic score, suitability or approvals.
rules: The technical-review responses here supplement sourceIssue flags; original flags remain until evidence and user instructions support clearing.
Never present this as a replacement 0–5 rating gallery or mark the full historic review complete when fit is unknown.

No Fra Angelico/El Greco and no rejected artworks, none included.
No calendar/Bible runtime or parallel coverage data edits.
